event_name: Time 18:21 2022 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 18 - 20 November 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed multiple angles of video evidence. The driver of Car 47 braked too late into Turn 5 and ran into the rear of Car 6, causing a collision. The driver of Car 47 was wholly to blame for the collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
